summary: A local-news style piece about a wellness workshop series, "Setting Goals and Cultivating Resilience," led by coach Sophia Martinez at Greenleaf Community Center since September 15, 2023. The workshops combine practical goal-setting tools (SMART goals, vision boards), resilience training, accountability partners, and daily practices like meditation and journaling. Participants share testimonials, and the series will continue into the new year.
one_line: Sophia Martinez's interactive workshop series at Greenleaf Community Center teaches goal setting, resilience, and accountability, with participant testimonials, running since September 2023.
key_facts: The workshop series "Setting Goals and Cultivating Resilience" has been rolling out since September 15, 2023.
The first session was launched by personal development coach Sophia Martinez at the Greenleaf Community Center.
Sophia Martinez's philosophy: "It's about celebrating each step forward – no victory is too small."
On October 3, 2023, entrepreneur David Thompson said the workshop helped him pivot his business by setting specific, measurable, and timely goals.
Participants receive practical tools such as SMART goal-setting techniques and vision boards.
Maria Gonzalez, a recent college graduate, said breaking long-term goals into smaller tasks made her career journey less daunting.
The resilience-focused portion of the workshops began on November 12, 2023.
Life coach and guest speaker Ryan Lee spoke on November 20, saying "Resilience is not about never falling; it's about learning how to get back up faster each time."
Lisa Marie, who overcame personal loss and rediscovered her passion for art, shared her story at a group session on December 1, 2023.
Accountability partners are assigned at the outset; Mark and Julie Anderson said they keep each other on track.
Suggested daily practices include meditation, journaling, and mindfulness exercises; participant Jack Robbins said they sharpened his focus and drive.
Each workshop ends with a reflection segment, and the series will continue into the new year.
